newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Boehler sees 96 result matching last year.
newsitem.headline: Boehler sees 96 result matching last year.

text.p: Austrian high-grade steel maker Boehler-Uddeholm said on Friday its 1996 pre-tax profit should match last year's level.
"Pre-tax profit will be similar to last year," chief executive Claus Raidl said at an investment fair. In 1995 Boehler posted a pre-tax profit of 1.35 billion schillings.
He reiterated that a higher tax burden would weigh on the net profit figure. Last year Boehler reported a net profit of 1.1 billion schillings.
Raidl declined to say whether Boehler would match its 1995 dividend of 25 schillings. "The pay-out ratio will be around 25 to 30 percent again," he said. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
